name: Christopher Alexander Whitmore
extra_bullets: Set up a simple feedback survey at the end of each module and review the comments every month to decide which screens need rewriting
Organized the school science fair for four years, including judging rubrics, volunteer schedules and a showcase night for about 300 families
cover_letter_paragraph: I also know what it is like to be new at something. Moving from the classroom to corporate training meant learning new tools and a new vocabulary in a short time. That experience keeps me patient with learners, and it shapes how I write instructions, examples and practice activities for people who are learning a job for the first time.
